title: 第一章 头犬第二章 光霞山
content_zh:
大将军出云中，扫阴山，荡北原，西至高阙，略河南地，至于陇西，获虏首二万三千级，车辎畜产，马牛羊百馀万，全甲兵而还，以三千八百户，封长平侯……
遂以河南地为朔方郡，徙四国八藩，人口六十万屯之。
“哔——”
天际里，一根哨箭划过晴空，逆风飞翔，骨制的箭头在草原上吹响嘹亮的哨音。
这音声中，一匹快马驰过山岗，奔过原野，在茫茫草场上扬起一线沙尘。
马上的青年骑士赤背裸身，肤色黑红，面刺青黥，脚上还带着锉断的镣铐，分明是个北虏出身的逃奴。
“驾！驾！”“哈哈哈！逃得好快！”“快出塞了！可莫走了虏子，叫人笑话！”“欸欸！可别射着老子的马！”
随后一阵喧嚣，一群膀大腰圆，骏马弯弓，喝的浑身酒气的将门良家子们，也跟着越过草场丘陵。
他们一个个醉醺醺的，面目通红，吆五喝六，纵马奔驰，不急不徐得跟在逃奴身后，歪歪斜斜得乱箭射来，从逃奴身边飞飘出去。
这种行酒投壶似的射术，若要被几十年前，他们扫荡阴山漠北的父祖辈看到，大概要气得昏死过去。
不过无所谓，仙宫定鼎万载，三垣坐稳江山，四宗八藩十二国镇压天下，天下收兵纵马南山很久了。何惧一两个豢养的虏子？
何况还带了狗呢。
“镝——！”
眼见着那逃奴仗着身轻马快，骑术精湛，就要从猎圈中奔逃出去，为首的追骑士弯弓吊射，高高得飞出一支金鸣的哨箭。
于是四面八方的草场中，忽然扑出一大群猎犬，比起这些吊儿郎当的良家子骑士，它们倒更像军队一般严谨，如一张大网，从八方围堵上来！
这些大如虎豹的狼犬，双目放着寒光，獠牙里挂着血气，肉眼可见的加速疾奔，直朝逃奴扑来！
但那逃奴却也厉害，在马背上左晃右避，飞身闪过狼犬的扑咬，竟还猿臂轻舒，伸手一捞，把一支轻飘飘从身边飞掠过的箭矢捞回来，反手插在扑将上来的狼犬眼眶里。
“嗷呜呜！”
“混账！我的狗！”“这刁奴！”“咬它！咬它！咬死它！”“别伤着我的马！”
骑士们大声喧哗，吵吵闹闹，乱成一团。

狼犬左扑右拦，虽然把马匹拦在了猎圈里，但因为那逃奴夺了利箭在手，一时也无法把那逃奴拖下马来，只反复飞扑，撕得他身上鲜血淋漓。
而逃奴一见马速被犬群拖慢下来了，也知道在劫难逃，却也不愿意束手就擒！
与其被抓回去，折磨凌辱至死，还不如像祖辈一样，死在这苍天下！草原上！
“喝！”
一声大喝！如当空炸雷！竟惊得追兵们险些翻下马来！
黥首逃奴竟飞身下马，一拳将一头狼犬，砸得脑浆迸流！热血泼面！
这个瞬间，他竟浑身肌肉迸发，气血暴涨，整个人拔地而起，身形长出七尺！化做个青面獠牙的人型巨怪！
“妖化！”“这！这杂虏竟觉醒了！”“换箭！换箭！”
这下良家子们可吓得酒醒了，慌忙抽出破甲猎矢，依着虽不熟习，倒也练过的弓马之术，纵犬群在前围猎，策马绕着这黥首巨怪飞驰，弯弓搭箭，五步射面，嗖嗖一片箭雨速射而来！直接把这赤身裸背的逃奴射成个鲜血淋漓的刺猬！
“嗷——！！蛮骨腾格里！”
逃奴大呵一声，忍着凌厉的箭雨，入骨的犬牙，竟大发凶威！一扯一折一撕！竟把一头狼犬擒着，掰头裂口！撕成两半！
泼天的血雨中，逃奴怒呵，群犬哀嚎，奔马嘶鸣，良家子尖叫！
而正当时！一道黑影猛然蹿出犬群！
竟是一个趴在地上，手足着地，披头散发，像狗一样飞爬的小孩！
这犬孩身型瘦小，还不及狼犬大，但猛然增速爆发！嗖！得窜上刚才被逃奴弃置的战马，猛得一扯缰绳！
那战马被扯得抬足高鸣，抬腿立起来，双足朝巨怪头顶踏来！
逃奴一惊，抬手握住马腿扛住战马的冲击！
而同时那马背上黑影一窜！犬孩趁机跃到逃奴背上，忽然拔出射了他满身，皮肉骨头上那些射偏的箭矢，直插入逃奴双目！
content_en:
The general came out of the clouds, swept the Yin Mountains, swept the Beiyuan, reached Gaoque in the west, and briefly surveyed the Henan area. As for Longxi, he captured 23,000 people, chariots and livestock, more than a million horses, cattle and sheep. He returned with full armor and soldiers. He took 3,800 households and was granted the title of Marquis of Chang Ping...
So Henan was designated as Shuofang County and moved to the four kingdoms and eight vassals, with a population of 600,000.
"Beep——"
In the sky, a whistle arrow streaked across the clear sky, flying against the wind, and the bone arrow whistled loudly on the grassland.
In the sound of this sound, a fast horse galloped over the hills and across the fields, raising a line of dust on the vast grassland.
The young knight on the horse was naked, with dark red skin, tattoos on his face, and filed-off shackles on his feet. He was clearly a fugitive slave from Northern China.
"Drive! Drive!" "Hahaha! Escape so fast!" "We're almost out of the fortress! Don't leave the prisoner and make people laugh!" "Hey! Don't shoot my horse!"
Then there was a commotion, and a group of well-bred generals, with their horses and bows bent, and smelling of alcohol, also followed across the pasture hills.
They were all drunk, their faces were red, and they were shouting and galloping. They followed behind the escaped slaves in a leisurely manner. Arrows were shot at random and fluttered away from the escaped slaves.
If this kind of archery skills were seen by their ancestors who raided the Yinshan Mountains and Mobei decades ago, they would probably faint from anger.
But it doesn't matter, the Immortal Palace has been established for ten thousand years, the three walls have stabilized the country, the four sects, eight vassals and twelve kingdoms have suppressed the world, and the world has withdrawn its troops and marched to the Ma Nan Mountain for a long time. Why fear one or two captive captives?
Not to mention bringing a dog.
"Dyprosium——!"
Seeing that the escaped slave was about to escape from the hunting circle with his light horse, fast horse and superb riding skills, the leading knight chasing him bent his bow and fired, and a golden whistle arrow flew high.
So a large group of hounds suddenly appeared in the pastures in all directions. Compared with these carefree knights, they were as rigorous as an army, like a big net, surrounding them from all directions!
These wolf-dogs, as big as tigers and leopards, had cold eyes and blood in their fangs. They were speeding up visibly to the naked eye, rushing towards the escaped slaves!
But the escaped slave was also very powerful. He swayed left and right on horseback, dodged the wolf dog's bite, and even relaxed his arms. He stretched out his hand and fished back an arrow that flew past him. He inserted his backhand into the eye socket of the wolf dog that was about to attack.
"Ouch!"
"Bastard! My dog!" "This naughty slave!" "Bite it! Bite it! Bite it to death!" "Don't hurt my horse!"
The knights were noisy, noisy, and confused.
The wolf dogs pounced left and right, and although they blocked the horse in the hunting circle, because the escaped slave had seized the sharp arrow in his hand, they were unable to drag the escaped slave off the horse for a while. They only flew repeatedly, tearing blood dripping from his body.
When the escaped slave saw that his horse was slowed down by the dogs, he knew that he was doomed, but he was unwilling to surrender!
Rather than being taken back and tortured and humiliated to death, it is better to die like our ancestors in this world! On the grassland!
"Drink!"
A loud shout! Like thunder exploding in the sky! The pursuers were so frightened that they almost fell off their horses!
The tattooed runaway slave flew off his horse and punched a wolf dog until his brains burst out! Hot blood splashing on the noodles!
At this moment, his muscles burst out, his energy and blood surged, and he stood up from the ground, growing seven feet! Transform into a humanoid giant with a green face and fangs!
"Demonization!" "This! This bastard has awakened!" "Change arrows! Change arrows!"
At this time, the good men were so frightened that they sobered up. They hurriedly drew out their armor-piercing hunting arrows. Using the art of bow and horse, which they were not familiar with but had practiced, they let the dogs hunt in front of them. They galloped around the tattooed monster, bent their bows and nocked arrows, and shot in the face in five steps. A hail of arrows came at a rapid rate! Directly shoot this naked escaped slave into a bloody hedgehog!
"Ouch——!! Barbarian Tengger!"
The escaped slave roared loudly, enduring the fierce rain of arrows, and the canine teeth that penetrated his bones became fierce! Pull one by oneFold it and tear it apart! He actually captured a wolf dog and chopped off its head and split it open! Tear in half!
In the rain of blood, the escaped slaves roared in anger, the dogs howled, the galloping horses neighed, and the good sons screamed!
And that's just the time! A black shadow suddenly jumped out of the dog group!
It was actually a child lying on the ground, with his hands and feet on the ground, his hair disheveled, and flying around like a dog!
This dog boy is small and thin, not as big as a wolfdog, but his growth rate explodes! Whoosh! He had to jump onto the war horse that had just been abandoned by the escaped slaves, and he had to pull the reins fiercely!
The war horse was pulled so hard that it screamed loudly, raised its legs, stood up, and stepped towards the giant monster's head with both feet!
The escaped slave was startled and raised his hand to hold the horse's leg to withstand the impact of the war horse!
At the same time, a black shadow scurried out on the horse's back! The dog boy took the opportunity to jump on the back of the escaped slave, suddenly pulled it out and shot him all over his body. The arrows that missed the target on the skin, flesh and bones went straight into the escaped slave's eyes!
